nights.title: Jethro Tull - The Curiosity Tour
nights.name: Jethro Tull
nights.extract: Jethro Tull are a British rock band formed in Blackpool, Lancashire, in 1967. Emerging from the 1960s British blues scene, the band soon developed a distinctive progressive rock sound, blending hard rock, English folk music and classical music, while undergoing numerous stylistic shifts throughout its history. The band was founded and has been continuously led by Ian Anderson, its principal composer, lead vocalist, and multi-instrumentalist best known for his flute playing. de.who: Jethro Tull sind eine britische rockband, die 1967 in Blackpool, Lancashire, gegründet wurde. Aus der britischen blues-szene der 1960er jahre entwickelte die band bald einen eigenen progressive-rock-klang, der hard rock, englische folkmusik und klassische musik verbindet. Gegründet wurde die band von Ian Anderson, ihrem hauptkomponisten, leadsänger und multiinstrumentalisten, der vor allem für sein flötenspiel bekannt ist, und er leitet sie seither ununterbrochen.

Grup, baş bestecisi, baş vokalisti ve flütüyle tanınan çok enstrümanlı müzisyen Ian Anderson tarafından kuruldu ve o, grubu kesintisiz olarak yönetti.

nights.title: Polyphia: BE NOT AFRAID World Tour
nights.name: Polyphia
nights.extract: Polyphia is an American rock band based in Plano, Texas, formed in 2010. The group consists of guitarists Tim Henson and Scott LePage, bassist Clay Gober, and drummer Clay Aeschliman. Rooted in a heavy metal sound in their early releases, the band's music evolved into a more progressive rock style in their later productions, combining elements of electronic and hip-hop music. Polyphia has released five studio albums, one live record, two EPs, and numerous singles.
